title_cn: 里德：目前与伊朗没有好的选择
summary: Sen. Jack Reed (D-RI) says the Pentagon has failed to adequately communicate with both Republicans and Democrats about operations in Iran. Reed says that issues with prolonged deployments and operations are not isolated to USS Abraham Lincoln but as well as other ships and units on the ground. Reed says Senate Armed Services Committee Chairman Roger Wicker shares concerns about the Lincoln and that the issue should come before the committee. He speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
